artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

mechanism_separation.current_model: Artillery has a five-second cast-start cooldown, approximately ten frames to projectile birth, ninety further frames to impact and 1.2 splash radius. Neutral priority precedes operator selection. Ordinary medics heal deployed operators, not civilians.
mechanism_separation.gamedata: Stage movement multiplier is 0.5; artillery raw speed is 0.5 and acquisition radius is 2.0. Roadblocks have 8000 HP, 200 DEF and 20 RES.
mechanism_separation.unknown: Exact client timing and tie-breaks, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and any artillery movement hold remain unestablished.
mechanism_separation.user_confirmed: Attack baiting, sacrifice and staged retreat are authorized tactical possibilities. Their benefits require a specific expressible attack behavior.

provenance.causal_battle_history: M73 V1–V5 from the supplied registered feedback; their event frames are conditional on their respective structures.
provenance.verification_performed: Read-only source/evidence inspection, declared-ledger arithmetic, range transformation and SP interval checks. No stage simulation or file mutation.
